title: Worker contract, result verification, and bounded retries
objective: Enforce worker restrictions, parse the standard English Task Report, independently verify scope/diffs/tests, preserve interrupted work, and retry/fail per bounded policy.
acceptance_criteria: Workers cannot commit/push, mutate GitHub, resolve threads, merge, or write shared State by contract/tool permissions where supported.
Report includes Issue, status, summary, files, tests, decisions, issues, blockers.
Main Agent verifies actual diff, allowed paths, secrets, and relevant checks independent of report.
Failure blocks only task and hard dependents; independent tasks continue.
At most two retries after initial attempt; repeated identical/non-retryable errors stop early.
Interrupted workspaces are preserved and ambiguous changes require review.
undo_classification: Retain worker artifacts/reports after failure; only clean verified owned files.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; identical failure escalates immediately.
